{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-khhi","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-eu0i: TestProtect::protect_request maps all ReservationError variants to SeqExhausted","description":"In lib.rs tests, the TestProtect::protect_request impl does:
```rust
self.reserve_sender(&mut store)
    .map_err(|_| OscoreError::SeqExhausted)?
    .protect_request(code, options, payload)
```
This maps ALL ReservationError variants (Conflict, Storage, SequenceExhausted) to SeqExhausted. This masks the true error cause - e.g. when a context is inactive (active=false), reserve_sender returns Conflict, but the test sees SeqExhausted. This makes debugging test failures harder.
